items.title: GTA 6's 'Unpredictable' Microclimate Revealed by The Weather Channel, with New PS5 Screenshots
items.summary: The Weather Channel shared an exclusive Rockstar look at Leonida's dynamic weather system, including new PS5 screenshots and comments from a lighting and rendering developer.

items.title: New GTA 6 Update Released by Rockstar Games on PS5 and Xbox
items.summary: Rockstar pushed a second pre-launch update (01.002.001, about 600 MB) with no patch notes, rolled out in stages three days after the first.

items.title: GTA 6 hacker pleads guilty to stealing and leaking gameplay footage
items.summary: Arion Kurtaj pleaded guilty at Woolwich Crown Court to the 2022 Rockstar breach and other Lapsus$ crimes, and will be sentenced at a later date.

items.title: GTA 6 Nearing 15 Million Copies Sold And $1.5 Billion In Revenue, And The Game Isn't Even Out Yet
items.summary: Sensor Tower's tracker puts pre-purchases at 14.94 million units (about $1.45B), with PS5 at roughly 74% of sales and a projection of up to 25 million by launch.

items.title: GTA 6 Day Off Doctor's Excuse Note Provided by Xbox, DJ Khaled
items.summary: Xbox and DJ Khaled's 'Dr. Xbox' launched a site that generates a joke doctor's note so players can take Thursday's launch day off.

items.title: Rockstar announces GTA 6 free code giveaways on Kick and Twitch
items.summary: Rockstar is giving away free GTA 6 codes through a Kick reward-case campaign running to December 7 (10,000 Ultimate Edition codes) and a Twitch giveaway running November 19–30.

items.title: 'GTA VI' Poses A Threat To Streaming Viewership
items.summary: Forbes cites Sensor Tower's estimate of 12.13M presales worth $1.18B and argues the launch will compete with streaming services for evening viewing hours.

items.title: GTA 6 AI Cloning Is Not a Financial Threat, Says Take-Two CEO
items.summary: Strauss Zelnick told IGN that AI-driven reverse-engineered game clones and unofficial PC ports aren't a financial threat to Take-Two, but he called them a creative concern.

items.title: 'GTA 6' Reveals Jason And Lucia's Limited Crime Options To Start
items.summary: A Guardian interview with Rockstar's Rob Nelson says Jason and Lucia begin with tiered, small-time crimes such as hotwiring low-end cars and robbing convenience stores before bigger heists unlock.

items.title: GTA 6 Album Leak Lists Dua Lipa, Jennie, and Lana Del Rey
items.summary: A vinyl video appears to reveal the full 34-track GTA 6: The Album tracklist, including Dua Lipa, Jennie, Lana Del Rey and Zara Larsson.
